import Link from 'next/link'
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Appointments — InkOS',
}

const APPOINTMENTS_TABS: PageTab[] = [
  {
    key: 'list',
    label: 'All',
    href: '/appointments?tab=list',
  },
  {
    key: 'today',
    label: 'Today',
    href: '/appointments?tab=today',
  },
  {
    key: 'waitlist',
    label: 'Waitlist',
    href: '/appointments?tab=waitlist',
    hidden: (role) =>
      role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin' && role !== 'receptionist',
  },
]

interface Props {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>
}

export default async function AppointmentsPage({ searchParams }: Props) {
  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
  if (!auth) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()
  let plan: PlanTier = 'solo'
  const { data: sub } = await supabase
    .from('subscriptions')
    .select('plan_tier')
    .eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .maybeSingle()

  const role = auth.role as NavRole
  const params = await searchParams
  const rawTab = typeof params.tab === 'string' ? params.tab : undefined
  const activeKey = rawTab && VALID_KEYS.has(rawTab) ? rawTab : 'list'

  return (

        actions={
          <Button size="sm" render={<Link href="/appointments/new" />}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            New booking
          </Button>
        }
      />
